newsitem.title: USA: Deloitte Touche fiscal year revenues rise 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Deloitte Touche fiscal year revenues rise 9.5 pct.

text.p: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu International said its revenues for fiscal 1996 rose 9.5 percent to $6.5 billion.
The company said the rise was due to increased international business.
The company also said that going forward, it would invest heavily in Russia, China, central Europe and India and build its operations through the Asia Pacific region.
It did not say how much it would invest. Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
The company offers worldwide accounting and consulting services.
